assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are approximate centroids and schematic boundaries derived from public announcements and map services, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios, figures and spatial decisions are suitable only for conceptual discussion; they must be recalculated from official polygons when released.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI concept submission, but no statutory, parcel-level, ownership or engineering conclusion may be drawn from it.

assumptions.statement: Bookstore locations, operational status, and founding dates are based on participant's firsthand visits (gloriousbooks.xyz), cross-verified with Brave Search results as of August 2026. Douban Bookstore closure (Sept 2025) confirmed via multiple news sources.
assumptions.impact: Bookstore data is more reliable than typical agent-inferred data but still subject to change (closures, relocations). The proposal's spatial strategy does not depend on any single bookstore remaining open—it addresses the systemic pattern.

assumptions.statement: GPS coordinates for bookstores and zones are approximate, derived from street addresses via public map services. Precision is ±100m for most points.
assumptions.impact: Trail length (3.2km) and node spacing are estimates. Precise routing requires field survey and pedestrian-network GIS analysis.

assumptions.statement: The shared-lease mechanism (AI companies funding 50sqm bookstore space per 1000sqm office) is a design proposal, not an existing policy or tested model.
assumptions.impact: Implementation requires policy negotiation, legal framework design, and pilot testing. The economic rationale (AI needs humanistic feedback loops) is argued but not quantitatively proven.
